subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox core own this dedicated SSM-only AWS workspace service and its ECS/CloudFormation deployment as a supported product surface?
rationale: The PR creates a specialized API mode, infrastructure stack, configuration contract, and long-term operating commitment that requires explicit maintainer intent beyond code correctness.

options.title: Accept as supported core mode
options.body: Sponsor the dedicated service after live acceptance proof, branch refresh, completed checks, and changelog cleanup.

options.title: Narrow to reusable primitives
options.body: Keep generic AWS provider and credential capabilities while moving the opinionated deployment outside the supported core surface.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold or close the PR until dedicated-account demand and long-term operational ownership are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Accept as supported core mode
recommendation.body: Sponsor the dedicated service after live acceptance proof, branch refresh, completed checks, and changelog cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main and historical ownership signal across the affected AWS and workspace runtime paths.
